import datetime

# Build union of song IDs appearing in either library or any playlist
library_song_ids = [s['song_id'] for s in all_library_songs]
union_song_ids = sorted(set(library_song_ids) | set(unique_playlist_song_ids))
print('library_count', len(library_song_ids), 'unique_playlist_count', len(unique_playlist_song_ids), 'union_count', len(union_song_ids))

song_release_year = {}
missing_release = []
for i, sid in enumerate(union_song_ids):
    info = apis.spotify.show_song(song_id=sid)
    rd = info.get('release_date')
    if rd:
        # rd format: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS or similar
        year = int(str(rd)[:4])
        song_release_year[sid] = year
    else:
        song_release_year[sid] = None
        missing_release.append(sid)
    if i < 5:
        print('sid', sid, 'release_date', rd)

print('songs_with_release_year', sum(1 for v in song_release_year.values() if v is not None))
print('missing_release_count', len(missing_release))

# Determine songs released after 2021
released_after_2021 = {sid for sid, yr in song_release_year.items() if yr is not None and yr > 2021}
print('released_after_2021_count', len(released_after_2021))

# Library removal set
library_to_remove = sorted([sid for sid in library_song_ids if sid in released_after_2021])
print('library_to_remove_count', len(library_to_remove))
print('library_to_remove_sample', library_to_remove[:20])

# Playlist per-playlist removal lists
playlist_removals = []
for p in all_playlists:
    sids = p.get('song_ids', [])
    to_remove = [sid for sid in sids if sid in released_after_2021]
    playlist_removals.append((p['playlist_id'], p['title'], to_remove))

total_playlist_songs_to_remove = sum(len(t[2]) for t in playlist_removals)
print('total_playlist_song_removals_count', total_playlist_songs_to_remove)
# show first few playlists needing removals
need = [t for t in playlist_removals if t[2]]
print('playlists_with_removals_count', len(need))
print('sample_playlist_removals', [(pid,title,len(to_remove)) for pid,title,to_remove in need[:5]])

# Verification pass (exactly once): re-fetch library and playlists and ensure no songs with release year > 2021 remain

# Re-fetch all library songs
page_index = 0
page_limit = 20
remaining_library_songs = []
while True:
    page = apis.spotify.show_song_library(access_token=spotify_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    print('verify library page', page_index, 'count', len(page))
    if not page:
        break
    remaining_library_songs.extend(page)
    page_index += 1

remaining_library_song_ids = [s['song_id'] for s in remaining_library_songs]
remaining_in_library_after_2021 = sorted(set([sid for sid in remaining_library_song_ids if sid in released_after_2021]))
print('verify total_library_songs_after', len(remaining_library_songs))
print('verify remaining_in_library_after_2021_count', len(remaining_in_library_after_2021))
print('verify remaining_in_library_after_2021_sample', remaining_in_library_after_2021[:20])

# Re-fetch all playlists
page_index = 0
page_limit = 20
remaining_playlists = []
while True:
    page = apis.spotify.show_playlist_library(access_token=spotify_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    print('verify playlist page', page_index, 'count', len(page))
    if not page:
        break
    remaining_playlists.extend(page)
    page_index += 1

remaining_playlist_occurrences_after_2021 = 0
remaining_playlist_song_ids_after_2021 = set()
for p in remaining_playlists:
    sids = p.get('song_ids', [])
    for sid in sids:
        if sid in released_after_2021:
            remaining_playlist_occurrences_after_2021 += 1
            remaining_playlist_song_ids_after_2021.add(sid)

print('verify total_playlists_after', len(remaining_playlists))
print('verify remaining_playlist_occurrences_after_2021', remaining_playlist_occurrences_after_2021)
